title: Geekvape Soul Replacement Pods 2ml - 2 Pods
description: The Geek Vape Soul Replacement Pods are designed to keep your Geek Vape Soul Vape Kit operating at peak performance. These refillable 2ml pods are available in two resistance options – 1.0ohm and 0.6ohm – offering flexibility to suit your preferred vaping style. Whether you enjoy the tighter draw and stronger throat hit of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping or the richer clouds and smoother draw of RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping, there’s a Soul Pod for you. Each pod features an integrated mesh coil, designed to enhance flavour and vapour production, ensuring a consistently satisfying vape. The pods are easy to refill with their top-fill design, making them both convenient and mess-free. The secure magnetic connection ensures that the pods stay firmly in place, yet they are easy to replace when needed. With their precision-engineered design, the Geek Vape Soul Replacement Pods offer excellent longevity and performance, helping you get the most out of your vaping experience. Whether you’re a new vaper or an experienced enthusiast, these pods provide a versatile, high-quality solution for your vaping needs. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
